extension.summary: Smooth Prime: Prime Video in the Aurora Cinema interface
extension.description: Smooth Prime is maintained by AgreeWithScotty. Catalog, account authentication, HTTPS transport, media resources, Widevine license relay, subtitles and playback lifecycle use independently written implementations. The dedicated Aurora interface is adapted from Scott's SmoothFlix. Not affiliated with Amazon. See NOTICE.md for asset and dependency licenses.
extension.disclaimer: Uses your own Amazon account and Kodi InputStream Adaptive with Widevine. Not affiliated with Amazon.
extension.news: 0.2.28[CR]- Use Amazon's category-navigation cover images and name overlays directly, without opening any genre catalog to obtain artwork.[CR]- Seed all 12 current public category covers for immediate binding; refresh one shared Categories response for Movies and TV.[CR]- Remove the per-genre preview queue, unrelated-section warming, and duplicate grid thumbnail downloader.[CR]- Start on Movies, the first top-menu item, with its genre grid. Do not fetch In Progress or full catalog pages at startup.[CR]- Refresh category metadata/artwork on existing tile objects without resetting the grid or its selection.[CR]- Show genre names only inside the graphic; remove duplicated below-art labels/captions and fill that space with artwork.[CR]- Empty-view restoration returns to the active section's menu instead of jumping to In Progress.[CR]- Preserve the established layout, individual Extras services, TV seasons/episodes, selected-category first-two-page lookahead, focus, fonts, account purge and playback behavior.
